scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w shared && npm test -w server && npm test -w client
